APPROVE
`BuildPlan` is now about 6 by cognitive complexity: one `foreach`, one `if`/`else if` with two `&&` sequences, and no nesting beyond that. Behaviour is unchanged because a failed `is var (eventIndex, documentIndex)` match on the null tuple simply skips the method, just as the old `continue` did, and the extracted helpers capture the same values. The code should compile cleanly as written, though I reviewed only the diff and did not run a build.
